input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset (and other) email links are built from `BASE_URL = process.env.PUBLIC_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000"`. In production, the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable is apparently not set (or not set for the environment serving these users), so the code falls back to the localhost default, producing unusable links like `http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=...`. Fix by ensuring `PUBLIC_URL` is configured for all production deployments, and consider failing loudly (or using a safer default) when it's missing so this doesn't silently regress after future releases.

input.title: Fix password reset email using localhost instead of production URL
input.body: File: src/notifications/templates.ts. The BASE_URL constant falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, which causes password reset (and other) email links to point at localhost in production. The fix should ensure PUBLIC_URL is properly configured/required in production environments (e.g. throw or log an error if missing in production, or ensure deployment config always sets PUBLIC_URL) so that passwordResetEmail and other link-generating functions in this file produce a reachable production URL instead of silently falling back to localhost.
